title: Introduce replayable eval checkpoints and automatic rollback CI hook
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Add a replayable evaluation checkpoint mechanism and a CI hook that compares checkpoints to baselines and triggers an automated rollback policy when regression thresholds are exceeded. Includes docs and tests.
description:
Motivation: We need a deterministic, auditable way to snapshot eval runs so that regression checks can be replayed exactly (same seeds, tokenization, env) and so that CI can trigger an automated rollback when a model or config change causes a measurable quality regression. This PR adds a lightweight eval checkpoint format, a replay runner, persistent snapshot storage integration, and a CI hook that gates merges based on checkpoint comparisons.

What this changes: - eval_harness/checkpoints: new checkpoint format (metadata + compressed outputs) and a small Python API for writing/reading checkpoints. - eval_harness/replay: deterministic replay runner that restores RNG/seed, tokenizer state and KV cache stubs to replay model outputs for exact diffing. - storage/snapshot_store: pluggable S3/GCS local filesystem backend with retention and manifest. - ci/hooks/rollback_gate.yaml: CI configuration that downloads baseline checkpoint for the PR scope and runs a comparison using a configurable metric set (accuracy/F1/ROUGE and coverage). If regression exceeds thresholds for any primary metric, the hook annotates the PR and creates a Linear rollback task (ENG-5921) and, when configured, triggers the delivery pipeline to mark the candidate build as failed. - tests: unit + integration tests that simulate checkpoint creation and replay with seeded pseudo-models. - docs/eval_checkpoints.md: usage, storage cost considerations, and guidance on choosing metrics and thresholds.

Design notes: - Checkpoint format is JSONL header + gzipped protobuf payload for outputs; header has run_id, commit_sha, model_variant, seed, dataset_cohort, environment tags and metric summaries. This balances readability and compact storage. - Replay runner enforces seeded determinism and canonical tokenizer versioning to avoid false positives. It supports a 'light' replay mode for CI (skip heavy model steps using cached outputs) and a 'full' mode for local developer debugging. - To keep CI runtime reasonable, the hook compares aggregated metrics at cohort-level and only runs full per-example diffs when a metric is near-threshold. - Storage retention defaults to 90 days; older snapshots are pruned by manifest sweeper.

How to review: - Focus on the checkpoint header fields (eval_harness/checkpoints/schema.py) — missing or mis-typed metadata will make replays fragile. - Review the replay determinism tests (tests/test_checkpoint_replay.py) for edge-cases (tokenizer updates, padding changes). - CI hook config (ci/hooks/rollback_gate.yaml) should be safe: it runs in a sandboxed job with read-only access to snapshots.

Backwards compatibility: The checkpoint reader is versioned; older checkpoints are migrated on read where possible. No breaking API surface change expected for external callers.

Related: ENG-5921 (rollback automation), ENG-6010 (eval infra cost cap).

c3f88aa: add snapshot storage backend and manifest sweeper

review_comments: Ethan Zhao: Great direction. Two quick asks: 1) Can we add explicit tokenizer-version pinning in the header? I worried about tokenization drift causing spurious diffs. 2) Please add cost estimate per checkpoint (S3 size) so infra can set retention defaults.

Priya Menon: Addressed — tokenizer_version added to header and included in migration logic. Added a table in docs/eval_checkpoints.md with empirical sizes from small/medium/large evals and retention recommendations.

Carlos Ruiz: Tests look good; one nit on naming: replay_runner.run -> replay_runner.execute_for_ci to make intent clearer. Also please ensure the CI job runs under a restricted service account with read-only snapshot access.
Priya Menon: Renamed the method and updated the CI job to use the snapshot-readonly SA. Added a comment describing expected IAM role. Updated test harness to assert SA usage in CI config.
Maya Patel: Security review: confirm that checkpoints do not contain PII. We should add a scrub step for known PII patterns before upload.
Priya Menon: Added a scrubber pipeline hook and a test case. The upload step refuses to publish if scrubber flags potential PII and will surface a human review action.
Ethan Zhao: CI initially flaked due to a parallel download race; switching the manifest fetch to use a stable list fixed it. Verified CI job now passes locally and in remote runner.
merge_outcome: merged (squash) — PR merged by Maya Patel after approvals from Ethan Zhao and Carlos Ruiz. CI green on final run.
notes: This PR is the basis for follow-ups: a small CLI for creating checkpoints (ENG-6052) and a dashboard view to browse checkpoints by cohort and commit (ENG-6104).
